summary: CareTrust REIT filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a forward-sale equity offering of 10 million common shares (plus 1.5 million overallotment). The pre-IPO price was $41.14/share on May 15, 2026. Proceeds will be received upon physical settlement, expected within one year. The filing is a routine shelf takedown with structural mechanics (forward sale agreements, REIT ownership caps), not a special situation.
